i.norm: Verifies that {@link OptionGroup#toString()} renders an option that only has a long option (no short option) using the long-option prefix ("--"), followed by the option's description. Here the option is created with a null short name and a null long name, so its key resolves to the literal "null"; after setting an empty description, the rendered group is "[--null ]" (note the trailing space before the closing bracket, which separates the long option from its empty description).
Build an option with no short name and no long name, then give it an empty description.
